Schedule selected mode

Connect to iPhone

NATIVE APP PHASE
HOW THE REAL VERSION WORKS
1

CampOS App Shortcut

Expose “Start Recovery Mode,” “Start Sleep Mode,” and “End CampOS Mode” to Siri, Shortcuts, Spotlight, and the Action button.

2

iPhone Focus

The user links a CampOS Focus or Sleep Focus through Shortcuts. CampOS adapts its own content through Focus Filters when that Focus changes.

3

Optional app shields

With explicit Screen Time permission, the native app can shield selected apps during the mode’s schedule.

4

Mode actions

CampOS begins the matching walk, breathing, mobility, workout, playlist, or wind-down routine.

Important iOS limit: a normal third-party app cannot silently take over every iPhone setting or directly force Do Not Disturb. The safe design is user-approved Shortcuts, Focus Filters, notifications, and optional Screen Time authorization.
